description:
The upgrade path still speaks in VM terms. The free-plan notice reads "Your Free plan includes 3 Edge apps. Add a server to move up to the next plan, or contact us to raise your limit" — but there is no VM platform to add a server to, and Server is now a vestigial owner row minted per edge site.

Touches app/Enums/QuotaSurface.php, app/Models/Concerns/ManagesOrganizationQuotas.php, app/Models/Concerns/Site/ManagesEdgeHosting.php and app/Modules/Edge/Livewire/Index.php, all of which have uncommitted edits already. tests/Unit/QuotaSurfaceEdgeTest.php was added for this.

Finish it against the real Edge billing model so the upgrade call to action points somewhere that exists.
title: Fix the quota and plan surface for Edge-only
